main_text.p: repraesentatione secus abutatur, ut his ipsis sanctorum simulachris cultum eũ praestet, qui debetur ijs, quos repraesentant, imo huic potius cui debeant honorem debeant, hanc in eis collocantes fiduciam quae in Deum unice sit transferenda, siue ita erga mutas has imagines affecti, ut his aliqua parte sint affixi, aut huic quam illi addictiores, mea sententia nihil abscedunt ab ido lolatria, criminaliter peccates, in Deum, omnis honoris autorem. Postremo sic mihi persuadeo, nullum De peregri nationi bus in terris inquilinum esse quin siue ad uitam, siue ad supplicium peregrinetur. Quisquis ita uitam insti-tuerit, ut in praecepta Dei quae aut nescit, aut doceri non uult, impingat, huic frustra salutem expectari, etiamsi orbis omnes angulos expatiatur. Contraque qui illius obseruat praecepta iusta, haud posse interire, quamuis nusquam ille in tota

page.notes: Marginal note "De peregri nationi bus" is in the right margin; "bus" is set in italic. Some words of the first lines are doubtful due to the scan; the printed text reads "affecti" and "abscedunt" as shown. The final line may run on; the page ends mid-sentence. The small mark below the text is a catchword-like circle and is recorded as a foot mark only.
